Returns feedback_pending if still generating, or full feedback if ready.

GET /api/v1/daily-tasks/today
Returns the current user's daily task for today (UTC+5).
If no task exists yet, creates one based on user profile.
Lazily expires stale tasks from previous days.

post.description:
POST /api/v1/daily-tasks/today/respond
Submit a response to today's daily task.
Marks task as completed, updates streak, triggers AI feedback in background.

POST /api/v1/daily-tasks/today/skip
Skip today's daily task. No new task will be issued today.
Per business rules §21.13: skipped tasks are not re-issued on the same day.

Accept-Language is NOT supported — use X-Language-Preference or Profile SSOT.

Verify Telegram Login Widget callback and bind Telegram identity
to the unified user account.

Flow:
1. Verify HMAC signature from Telegram
2. Look up existing Telegram identity in user_identities
3. If web_user_id provided, try to merge with existing web user
4. Create or update user record
5. Return unified user_id + credits balance

primary_locale.title: Primary Locale
primary_locale.description: Transition alias for language_preference. Optional on PATCH. Valid enum updates Profile SSOT. Clearing not supported in MVP — unset users fall back to phone inference then default ru.

language_preference.title: Language Preference
language_preference.description: Formal name (KAZI-74). Maps to primary_locale DB column in MVP. Optional on PATCH. Valid enum updates Profile SSOT. Clearing not supported in MVP — unset users fall back to phone inference then default ru.

PatchMeBody.title: PatchMeBody
PatchMeBody.description: Partial profile update — all fields optional. Language: send language_preference (preferred) or primary_locale; if both sent, language_preference wins. Omit a field to leave unchanged; null is treated as omit (no clear-to-null in MVP).

locale.title: Locale
locale.description: Transition alias for per-turn language (KAZI-74). If both locale and language_preference are sent in the body, language_preference wins. Request headers outrank body fields.

language_preference.title: Language Preference
language_preference.description: Per-turn UI/chat language hint (KAZI-74 formal name). See X-Language-Preference header for full resolution order.

job_id.title: Job Id
job_id.description: Echoed when sent; prep_card generation is KAZI-32 (schema ahead of runtime).

InterviewPrepCard.title: InterviewPrepCard
InterviewPrepCard.description: Planned v0.2d depth (KAZI-32) — returned when ``job_id`` is set.

primary_locale.title: Primary Locale
primary_locale.description: Transition alias for language_preference (KAZI-74). Same value as language_preference when set. Null when Profile language not yet set.

language_preference.title: Language Preference
language_preference.description: User UI/chat/agent language (Profile SSOT). DB column still primary_locale in MVP.

LanguageCode.title: Language Code
LanguageCode.description: Supported UI/chat language (KAZI-74). Add new languages here only; reference via $ref elsewhere.

master_session_id.title: Master Session Id
master_session_id.description: Convenience duplicate of space.master_session_id for post-create navigation (design SDD §1.4); BE guarantees equality on create.

SpaceTurnEnvelopeComponent.title: SpaceTurnEnvelopeComponent
SpaceTurnEnvelopeComponent.description: Chat envelope component. ``text`` is populated when ``type`` is ``text``.

extensions.title: Extensions
extensions.description: Additional meta from orchestrator; TODO(P2): tighten per-envelope-type schemas.

SpaceTurnEnvelopeMeta.title: SpaceTurnEnvelopeMeta
SpaceTurnEnvelopeMeta.description: P0.5 core meta fields. Use ``extensions`` for forward-compatible keys (P2+).

SpaceTurnAttachment.title: SpaceTurnAttachment
SpaceTurnAttachment.description: File attachment on a space turn request.

X-Language-Preference.name: X-Language-Preference
X-Language-Preference.description: Explicit UI/chat language for this request (KAZI-74). Full resolution order (KAZI-74): (1) X-Language-Preference header; (2) body language_preference; (3) body locale; (4) X-Locale legacy header; (5) authenticated Profile language_preference (GET /me); (6) phone-country inference only when Profile unset; (7) default ru. Accept-Language is NOT supported — use X-Language-Preference or Profile SSOT.

X-Locale.name: X-Locale
X-Locale.description: Legacy header for pre-KAZI-74 clients (mirrors next-intl URL route segment). When both X-Language-Preference and X-Locale are present, X-Language-Preference wins. Will be deprecated after client migration; do not use as the sole language signal.
